viewing_check: Photograph the scratchplate signatures close up in good light and compare with known U2 autographs (Bono, Edge, Adam Clayton, Larry Mullen Jr). Photograph the Helping Hand Group COA (no. 16575) and plaques in full. Check headstock logo for Squier vs Fender, whether the guitar is actually fixed in the frame, glass condition and the frame size (91 x 111 cm). Signatures look faint, so check for fading.
